title: Middle Eastern Quenched Hojicha Brunch Tagine
description: A rich and spicy Middle Eastern-inspired dish, infused with the smooth flavor of hojicha and the crunch of quenched ingredients.

ingredients.name: brunch vegetables
ingredients.notes: mixed, such as bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the middle eastern spice blend and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the brunch vegetables and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the tagine sauce, hojicha, and quenched almonds. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional hojicha and quenched almonds if desired.
